name: Good Morning
cues: Set the bar across your upper back as you would for a squat
Unlock your knees and push your hips straight back
Lean forward with a flat back until your hamstrings stretch
Squeeze your glutes and bring your hips through until you stand tall

qa.note: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Hip flexion 2-80 deg and knee 3-15 deg. The trunk reaches 64.5 deg from vertical at the bottom while the hips travel back 39 cm (hip crease z 0.146 to -0.244). The bar stays locked to back_high (girdle/bar -0.2 mm under the 20 mm rest). Shins rake back about 6 deg (ankle df -6.5), the same as the RDL precedent. Glutes and hamstrings read clearly from the rear hero view.
